BlackPoint: Treat seeds with Tebuconazole 2% DS before sowing
Ensure proper grain drying and low moisture storage
Avoid delayed harvesting and maintain field hygiene
FusariumFootRot: Apply Carbendazim 50% WP as seed treatment
Use crop rotation with non-host crops
Improve soil drainage to reduce humidity
LeafBlight: Spray Mancozeb 75% WP or Chlorothalonil 75% WP
Destroy crop residues to reduce inoculum
Ensure adequate crop spacing for air flow
WheatBlast: Avoid late sowing and excess nitrogen application
Destroy infected crop residues after harvest
